items.title: Manuel "Fess" Manetta and Edward "Kid" Ory Interview, 1958-08-26
items.q: Frank Doosan had been out here, and they sent him back by not reading.

ctx.x: So, finally, they came right back with Tiger Rag, you know. They tried to trick you on that first. Mm-hmm. And boy, then I knew they was going to play, and they were playing in the right key, you know, the ring. And that was it.

So, uh, one day, I got out there then. Now, how it was, Frank Doosan had been out here, and they sent him back by not reading. And he said, here, he done sent the tickets to me on Lewis Armstrong, Johnny Dots, and Joe Lindsey. He's expecting. Of course, today, some fellas don't know that until today. I'm sure that happened now. I was going to get out. So, I had a ticket. I goes to Johnny Dots' house. Johnny Dots and his wife will accept me in. How to find him on a call. He had told his wife about it, but he had…

next to the ballroom. He goes with him and let's have a conversation over there. I don't know. I goes to his house. He didn't tell me. I noticed coming in a car, Louisiana Avenue car coming down. Now we come from Uptown to come see Dipper, get off at Petita and Rampart. I noticed he was kind of funny. He wouldn't say nothing. I said, well, he said, no, he wouldn't say nothing. So I said, well, I guess Dipper Rampart gets off. He goes down there, there's a little up in the place there, that ballroom there, a fella…
